title: Julich-Brain 3.0.3 · native cytoarchitectonic MPM
units_evidence: The official source map identifies ICBM152 nonlinear asymmetric 2009c. Its original affine and shape equal the supplied 1 mm MNI reference. The MPM omits header unit flags; source coordinate units are explicitly recorded in millimeters.

space.name: MNI ICBM152 2009c nonlinear asymmetric
space.reference: Julich-Brain 3.0.3 official source map configuration and ICBM152 2009c asymmetric reference
space.correspondence: The publisher maps this MPM into ICBM152 nonlinear asymmetric 2009c. Original T1, T2 and MPM grids have equal shapes and affines. Source definitions remain specific to this atlas.

sources.title: Julich-Brain Atlas, cytoarchitectonic maps
sources.citation: Amunts K, Eickhoff SB, Pieperhoff P, Bludau S, Caspers S, Mohlberg H, Lewis LB. Julich-Brain Atlas, cytoarchitectonic maps v3.0.3. EBRAINS. doi:10.25493/56EM-75H. Related method: Amunts K et al. Science 369, 988-992 (2020), doi:10.1126/science.abb4588.
sources.license_name: Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 4.0 International

sources.title: MNI ICBM152 nonlinear asymmetric reference
sources.citation: Fonov VS et al. Unbiased average age-appropriate atlases for pediatric studies. NeuroImage 54 (2011), 313-327. doi:10.1016/j.neuroimage.2010.07.033. Original ICBM152 2009c asymmetric reference.

label_mapping.region_evidence: Source maximum-probability assignment derived from postmortem cytoarchitectonic probability maps in the declared population reference. The original categorical assignment is preserved.
label_mapping.gap_evidence: Source-defined GapMap partition included by the publisher to complete cortical coverage. Its source name and categorical value identify its distinct evidence type.

scope_notes: 314 source entries comprise 302 hemisphere-specific regional assignments and 12 hemisphere-specific source GapMaps.
The categorical MPM records the source maximum-probability assignment; individual probability channels are a distinct source product.
Surfaces follow the original 1 mm categorical samples. Source definition, coverage and independent instructor judgments are recorded separately.
acquisition: Reuse verified original MPM and ICBM152 2009c asymmetric files. The exact source map configuration and source license metadata are acquired through the same workflow.

teaching_sequences.title: Central cortical source regions
teaching_sequences.objective: Recognize the original source parcellations and compare their three-dimensional positions with the supplied template MRI.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Inspect complete T1 and T2 sections first, then magnify the selected region and rotate its source-resolution surface.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Population maximum-probability assignments derived from postmortem cytoarchitectonic maps. Read each original source name and retain the 1 mm reference sampling.
